text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhhh!
Go, Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Isn't this incredible? You realize they're all cheering for you, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose it's only natural today.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Scarlet...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I had fun. Though, it's a bit strange,
don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Once you've got your own feelings in
order, you
somehow come to figure out
what's going through
everyone else's
heads when they run.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Take you, for example. You're on cloud
nine right
now, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I certainly am! I gave the race everything
I had, in
my own way.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... All right, that's enough. What am
I
supposed to say to you when you've
got that
enormous smile on your face?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Everybody's waiting! Off you go.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's wonderful. I've finally reached
it—this
wonderful view.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: For what?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... I wonder. I don't think it'd
sound good if
I tried to explain it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're very decisive, and I like that
about you.
Perhaps it's enough to say
that?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Decisive? Not me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I knew from the start how things
would
play out. I knew this was the end
of the road.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But where's the fun in that? So I kept
searching
for something that could
distort the result.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And that's when I found you, Fine. You
were
different. At first, all I cared about
was getting
some unique data and
analyzing it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But then, one day... you defied my
predictions. In
that moment, a thought
crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If anyone can change their fate, it's her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I thought if I could get you to keep
running—to
defy your destiny—then that
would prove that my
fate could change
as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So I put my faith in a dumb hypothesis and clung to it... like an idiot.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And in the end, I didn't run well enough
to change
anything.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even so... even with this result... This isn't
grounds
for you to give up, is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Come on now. As soon as the race
ended, I could
see every one of your
neurons firing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
When I spoke to you, I got a glimpse of
that face
of yours that I love so much.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Facing up to your discontent and
running with the
hope of never being
forgotten... I know what it's
like.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that the more you open up
about your
feelings, like just now... the
more they'll resonate
with the hearts of
others.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I did what I needed to for my sake. What
about
you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
How about you quit your yapping and
take a
hike?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Thank you, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Farewell...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we have a press conference
to
announce Fine Motion's return to
Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm all right.
...Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm very fortunate, aren't I? I'm a truly,
truly
blessed individual.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I got to run so much, and I made so
many friends.
I heard the glorious sound
of countless cheers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right. I'm sure they'll all remember me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And I believe it'll be a dazzling memory.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Fine!
Don't quit! Keep racing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much. However, I must
bring
these wonderful three years to a
close.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This exquisite ending has been decided
from the
very start.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Every race has a beginning and an end.
But in our
memories, it becomes more
than a simple
contest...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As long as you none of you forget me,
I'll live on
in your memories.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So please, allow me to stay... within your
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion's eyes glisten in rare fashion
as she
smiles on at the crowd.
